title: Reason for a missing link (gap)
description: Controlled vocabulary for provenance.status = missing and for gap records. A gap is shown, never silently filled.

x-descriptions.council_votes_not_machine_readable: Council votes are not available in machine-readable form since 2025-03-10.
x-descriptions.cellar_lag: Cellar has not (yet) recorded a Council step that must exist, e.g. between trilogue agreement and EP approval.
x-descriptions.ep_dea_without_c_code: The EP delegated-act procedure carries no Commission C number.
x-descriptions.match_below_threshold: A derived match exists but its quality is below 'medium'; candidates are only given in the API field 'candidates'.
x-descriptions.hys_without_com_reference: The 'Have your say' initiative lists no COM or C number that links it to a procedure.
x-descriptions.limite_metadata_only: The Council document is LIMITE; only its identifier, date and header are recorded.
x-descriptions.source_unavailable: The source could not be retrieved. Used only in source health, never on a procedure.
x-descriptions.not_yet_issued: The document is announced but not yet issued by the institution (e.g. verbatim report).
